gsc.latencyNote: Uses final Search Console data for the latest seven-day window ending two days ago.

methodology.rawPeriods: Unmodified Search Console aggregate totals, including anonymized queries.
methodology.decisionPeriods: Raw totals minus explicitly classified AgentStack query-page anomalies. Position is impression-weighted after subtraction.
methodology.queryPageRows: Classification uses up to 25,000 final query-page rows per period. Rules and every removed row are included under anomalies.
methodology.queryPageOpportunities: Query-page opportunities exclude classified anomalies and require at least 10 current impressions, CTR at or below 2%, and average position 20 or better.
methodology.dataQuality: Comparative recommendations are suppressed when final daily rows are incomplete or the current period has an abrupt traffic discontinuity against either the preceding week or the strongest complete week in the preceding four weeks.

rules.scope: AgentStack hub and episode query-page rows only
rules.url_or_api_reference: URL, API endpoint, repository path, or parameterized request copied from episode transcript text.

rules.machine_generated_boolean_query: Quoted or boolean search expression resembles an automated or copied transcript query.

methodology.snapshotWindow: One 24-hour export collected at a consistent daily time.
methodology.comparison: Latest 7 daily snapshots versus the preceding 7.
methodology.readersAndBots: Clarity totalSessionCount is treated as reader sessions; totalBotSessionCount is reported separately.
methodology.decisionThreshold: Page/device recommendations require at least 20 reader sessions unless an independently clear technical failure exists.
methodology.limitation: Clarity exposes at most 72 hours per request, so complete weekly comparison requires 14 stored daily snapshots.
